name: TeXmacs
blurb: TeXmacs is a free scientific editing platform designed to create beautiful technical documents using LaTeX in the background.
description:
TeXmacs is a free scientific editing platform designed
to create beautiful technical documents using LaTeX in
the background. It provides a unified and user friendly
framework for editing structured documents with different
types of content: text, mathematics, graphics, interactive
content, slides, etc.

This package contains:
Gnuplot, Graphviz and Eukleides.

It also has plugins that can extend the functionalities.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
